text:
jen: quick follow-up on the air-gapped upgrade flow — i want to propose a lightweight "HOLDING" stage instead of quarantine. semantic: artifacts are PULLED -> HOLDING -> STAMPED -> ACTIVATING -> ACTIVE. HOLDING is small-footprint and holds manifests + checksums, not full blobs.

marco: why HOLDING vs quarantine?

jen: name aside, the big idea is different retention defaults: HOLDING TTL is short (default 24h) and eviction prefers oldest manifests. we stream blobs only for STAMPED components. should help tiny SSD nodes.

anika: sounds useful. sidecar or builtin verifier? my lean: sidecar for key isolation and easier offline KMS handling.

rory: +1 sidecar. also we should avoid operator owning any private keys. sidecar takes escrow mode for airgap.

jen: proposed escrow UX: admin injects a sealed-escrow blob (operator-signed) once. sidecar verifies signatures locally. first-time install requires a console acknowledge and generates an audit entry.

marco: key rotation path?

jen: rotate via a rotation manifest signed by previous escrow or via maintenance-mode console approve. document manual emergency rotation path.

anika: retries and failure semantics?

jen: sidecar does 4 retries with jitter on transient checks, then returns REJECT and we mark component HOLDING-REJECT. operator emits event and exposes remediation link.

rory: partial activations are critical for customers. HOLDING must be per-component. operator keeps an ActivationPlan that applies stamps only for STAMPED components.

marco: observability: include activation_ref (sha256(manifest_compact||cluster_id||ts) truncated to 10 chars) in logs and traces.

jen: agreed. also add metrics: holding_items, holding_bytes, holding_evictions_total, holding_rejects_total.

anika: proto sketch? keep minimal.

jen: draft: service Verifier { rpc Stamp(StampReq) returns (StampResp); rpc Health(Empty) returns (Health); } message StampReq { string manifest_hash = 1; string component = 2; string activation_ref = 3; } message StampResp { enum Status { UNKNOWN=0; STAMPED=1; REJECT=2; RETRY=3;} Status status = 1; string code = 2; string sig = 3; }

rory: rollout plan?

jen: 1) ship sidecar + operator hooks in simulated mode (no state flips) for 7 days on canary. 2) enable HOLDING+STAMP flow for 5% clusters with activation_grace=3m. 3) expand to 25% then global if metrics stable.

ops-bot: <https://rwd.internal/rfcs/2026-12-holding-stage-stamped-activation|RFC-2026-12> added to #architecture-rfcs, reviewers: anika, marco, rory. :white_check_mark:

marco: i'll draft the sidecar proto and a small test harness for simulate_rejects.

jen: thanks — i'll update the RFC with defaults and the emergency rotation steps. tagging @anika @rory for last comments. :thumbsup:
